input.command: cd /workspace/inventory && git clean -ndx && echo "---IGNORED/UNTRACKED LIST---" && git status --ignored --short && echo "---VAR---" && ls -la var 2>/dev/null || echo "no var/" && echo "---FILES---" && ls -la

cd /workspace/inventory && cat .gitignore && echo "---ENV (keys only)---" && sed 's/=.*/=<redacted>/' .env && echo "---VAR DB TABLES---" && (command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null && sqlite3 var/local.db '.tables' || echo "sqlite3 not available")

cd /workspace/inventory && ls -R src tests && echo "---ENV USAGE---" && grep -rn "INVENTORY_API_TOKEN\|INVENTORY_ENV\|\.env\|var/" --include=*.py --include=*.toml --include=*.md . | grep -v '.git/' || true
cd /workspace/inventory && git clean -fdx -e .env && git reset --hard HEAD && rm -rf var/ && echo "---AFTER RESET---" && git status --short --ignored && ls -la
